plan.title: SRC-AWD-027 — Award Both Lines to Vendor B and Reject Blank Approval Remark

steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed two-bid event directly on Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for the case.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the available first line's full 10 units to Vendor B.
Verify that one line is selected, only Vendor B is awarded, and the proposal value is 10 × ₹90 = ₹900.
Create the award proposal from the allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Complete the proposal fields required before submission.
Submit the proposal so it reaches the approval stage.
Verify that the submitted proposal is pending approval.
